svg.title: The executor follows its own pull request to any base
svg.desc: Overview of ADR-0043. The executor reads a pull request from the request's own shadewright branch on every base branch of the configured repository, not only the target branch. Open on another base: the request stops NeedsIntervention with ChangeRequestOnOtherBase and keeps the lock, TargetHeld names the pull request and its base, nothing is written to it but a failed review check, any open pull request from the branch keeps the lock whether or not it carries the marker, and the finalizer of a deleted request closes only those with the request's marker, except where it lets go without closing. Merged on another base: the request stops NeedsIntervention with ChangeRequestOnOtherBase, also on a cancel, records no merge and keeps no lock. Closed on another base: handled as closed, no second pull request; the lock goes, and a number read as not found is gone, only after the listing of every base shows no open pull request from the branch. From a fork, another repository or another branch: in a listing ErrUntrustedAnswer for the whole call, nothing adopted or closed; by a recorded number, not the request's. More than 100 pull requests: ErrTooLarge, the lock is kept and the look is retried. Never on another base: no push, comment or merge, and no check run but a failed one at a stop.
svg.text: Request's own pull request
from its shadewright/ branch of the
configured repository, read by its
number or by its branch, on every
base branch, not only the target
only one with the request's marker
is adopted or closed
OPEN ON ANOTHER BASE
NeedsIntervention, ChangeRequestOnOtherBase; lock kept
TargetHeld names #N and its base (redacted, bounded). Only a failed review check is written.
Any open one from the branch keeps the lock, marked or not. Deletion closes marked ones only.
MERGED ON ANOTHER BASE
NeedsIntervention, ChangeRequestOnOtherBase
Also on a cancel. No merge is recorded, since it delivered nothing the request can verify.
It keeps no lock; the stop reason tells a person to look at the other branch.
CLOSED ON ANOTHER BASE
Handled as closed
No second pull request is opened. The lock is released, and a number read as not found is gone,
only after the listing of every base shows no open pull request from the branch.
FROM A FORK, ANOTHER REPOSITORY OR ANOTHER BRANCH
ErrUntrustedAnswer for the whole call of a listing
In a listing: nothing is adopted or closed; the look is retried, never taken as gone.
By a recorded number: not the request's (gone). Over 100 pull requests: ErrTooLarge, retried.
Never on another base
no push, comment or merge, no check run but a failed one at a stop; no close without the marker; no fork or other repository.
